snippet.title: The Secret of Weepstone | IHS 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
Grab your graph paper, your handbook, and your luckiest d20. The Secret Of Weepstone demo is OUT NOW! Step into a beautiful, hand-drawn world inspired by the early days of tabletop RPGs and explore, battle, level up, and die horrible deaths. 

Download the demo now: https://dreadxp.games/SecretofWeepstoneDemoYT

Follow the dev: https://x.com/talesworth

Join the community: https://discord.gg/ba5uW8ZSGd
